research_notes: SOURCES: every document was downloaded directly from CIMB Niaga's investor-relations site https://investor.cimbniaga.co.id/misc/... (served via the ir.listedcompany.com download tracker, no bot protection); no archive copies, no news and no aggregator values are stored. idx.co.id was not needed.

SHARIA UNIT SPIN-OFF: CIMB Niaga runs a sharia business unit (UUS, sharia financing Rp55.7tn and sharia deposits Rp50.3tn at Dec-25, FY2025 deck pp. 23-24). The EGMS of 26 Jun 2025 approved spinning it off into a new sharia commercial bank, PT Bank CIMB Niaga Syariah (AR2025 PDF pp. 423-425). The spin-off had NOT taken effect by FY2025 and still had not by 30 Sep 2026: the 9M2026 FS (authorised 28 Oct 2026, PDF p. 20) still describes the related board changes as effective only 'since the Effective Date of the Spin-Off'. So every fy.* figure 2019-2025 and the 9M2026 interim INCLUDE the unit, with no break in the series. The original target effective date was May 2026; press reports (e.g. bisnis.com, Jan 2026; fortuneidn.com) say it slipped to around Q4 2026 while the OJK business licence was pending. This was not verified in a company document. Once effective, the new bank is expected to be a consolidated subsidiary: press reports name PT Commerce Kapital, a CIMB Group affiliate that holds 1.02% of BNGA, as co-founder. Consolidated totals should then barely move, but the bank-only ratios and the bank-only base of the dividend payout will change, and non-controlling interest may rise. Re-check the consolidation scope in the FY2026 FS.

LOANS DEFINITION: fy.*.loans_gross and the interim loans = the FS line 'Kredit yang diberikan' before allowance, which includes the sharia unit's financing (FS2025 Note 12a lists conventional + sharia). It EXCLUDES 'Piutang pembiayaan konsumen' of subsidiary CIMB Niaga Auto Finance (CNAF, 83.28% owned), which sits on a separate line (Rp10.3tn at Dec-25). The AR highlights and the analyst decks report 'Loans' INCLUDING CNAF receivables (e.g. Dec-25 238,308.825 = 227,997.983 + 10,310.842). Stored values follow BMRI.json (FS loan line, multifinance excluded).

DEPOSITS: CIMB Niaga's consolidated balance sheet has no separate 'temporary syirkah funds' line; the sharia unit's deposits are inside 'Simpanan dari nasabah' (current/savings/time). fy.*.deposits = 'Jumlah simpanan dari nasabah' (= the AR 'Customer Deposits' and deck 'Total Customer Deposits').

RATIOS are CONSOLIDATED. The AR 'Financial Ratios' highlight table equals the 'Consolidated' block of each December published report (e.g. Dec-25: CAR 24.83, NPL 1.81, ROA 2.43, ROE 13.03, NIM 3.97, BOPO 72.40, CIR 45.92, LDR 86.81) and the decks' 'Key ratios - consolidated'. The 'Bank CIMB Niaga' (bank-only) block differs: Dec-25 NIM 3.69, ROE 13.58, CIR 47.00, LDR 82.84. FY2022-FY2025 come from AR2025 (PDF pp. 19-20). FY2020-FY2021 come from AR2021's MD&A key-ratio table (PDF p. 229), with LLC from AR2021 p. 18 and LAR from AR2025/AR2024. ROE stored = 'ROE Tier I' (OJK definition, as in the published reports); the shareholders'-equity ROE is given in each note.

FY2021 'BUSINESS AS USUAL' TRAP: AR2022-AR2025 highlight tables restate FY2021 (and FY2019) P&L figures 'business as usual', excluding exceptional items: 2021 net income 4,212.861 (attributable 4,214.597, EPS 169.06, ROA 1.88, ROE 10.73, CIR 45.88, BOPO 78.37). The audited FS2021 and FS2022 comparatives show 4,100.340 / EPS 164.48, and the statutory ratios are ROA 1.82, ROE 10.44, CIR 46.71, BOPO 78.97 (AR2021 p. 229; Dec-2021 published report). The exceptional item was an extraordinary G&A cost of Rp146.5bn (AR2021 PDF p. 222). The stored values are the statutory ones. AR2025's 2021 column carries no asterisk but uses the BAU values.

PSAK 71: adopted 1 Jan 2020 with a Rp4,139.102bn (net of tax) charge to opening retained earnings; FY2019 was not restated. Equity attributable fell from 43,278.891 (Dec-19) to 41,038.939 (Dec-20) partly because of this, not because of the year's results. FY2020 profit was depressed by COVID provisions (CoC 2.83%, LAR 23.64% incl. COVID restructuring).

NO RESTATEMENTS FY2019-FY2025: each FS's comparative columns equal the prior year's own FS (FY2025 FS presents three years, 2025/2024/2023, all equal to the originally reported figures). Only related-party vs third-party loan splits were reclassified (totals unchanged).

PAYOUT RATIO is defined by CIMB Niaga on BANK-ONLY ('Company only') net income, so payout_ratio has basis bank_only. Bank-only net income (Dec published reports, 'Bank' column): 2020 1,830.963; 2021 3,909.476; 2022 4,786.403; 2023 6,168.723; 2024 6,525.666; 2025 6,778.889 (IDR bn). Dividends / bank-only NI = 60.0/60.0/60.0/50.0/60.0/60.0%. On consolidated profit attributable the same dividends are 54.6/57.2/57.0/47.6/57.4/59.1%. The validator multiplies consolidated profit by the bank-only payout, so FY2020-FY2024 show >3% payout_total gaps; these are acknowledged in validation_ack (FY2025 is within 1.4%).

DIVIDENDS: exactly one final cash dividend per fiscal year, paid after the AGMS; there were no interim or special dividends from FY2020-FY2025 profit (IR dividend page https://investor.cimbniaga.co.id/dividend.html lists one payment per year: 2021 44.06, 2022 94.07, 2023 115.16, 2024 122.67, 2025 155.73, 2026 161.77). No FY2026 interim dividend had been announced as of the 9M2026 FS. The announcement totals are 'maximum' amounts and DPS 'minimum' amounts. For FY2024/FY2025 the paid totals equal the announced ones (FS 9M2026 Note 34). FY2023's announcement mis-states 'Net Income (Company only) for the Financial Year 2022'; the AGMS and AR2025 make clear it is FY2023.

CORPORATE ACTIONS 2019-01-01 to 2026-11-03: none of type split / reverse split / rights / bonus. The last rights issue (PUT V with HMETD) was in Dec 2010 and the last reverse split (10:1) in May 2004 (AR2025 PDF p. 112, share-listing chronology). AR2025 PDF p. 24 states that no stock split, reverse split, bonus issue or par-value change occurred in 2025. The only share issue in the window is a non-pre-emptive capital increase (PMTHMETD): 10,599,000 new class B shares (0.04%), approved by the EGMS of 11 Jan 2024, executed 31 Jan 2024 and listed 1 Feb 2024 (FS2025 Note 33, PDF p. 196). It has no rights and no ex-date, so it is not recorded as a corporate action. Treasury-share movements (2017/2019 buyback programmes, MRT/LTIP awards) change shares_out slightly from year to year. corporate_actions is therefore an empty list.
